title: ALMA and GMRT Studies of Dust Continuum Emission and Spectral Lines Toward Oort Cloud Comet C/2022 E3 (ZTF)
question: To study the radio and millimeter wavelength dust continuum emission and volatile molecular / atomic lines (CH3OH and HI) toward Oort cloud non-periodic comet C/2022 E3 (ZTF), and determine the dust production activity, CH3OH abundance, and its formation mechanism.

evidence.quote: Note: The orbital parameters of comet ZTF are taken from Bolin et al. (2022) and NASA JPL Horizons System.

recipe.goal: Measure millimeter dust continuum properties of comet ZTF
recipe.method: Fit a 2D Gaussian over the cometary area in each of the 6 frequency bands to measure integrated flux, peak flux, and deconvolved source size.

recipe.goal: Derive dust temperature and dust spectral index from continuum SED
recipe.method: Plot spectral energy distribution (SED) from 224.79 to 242.60 GHz and fit a blackbody model using MCMC.
assumptions: blackbody model with dust spectral index beta

recipe.method: Calculate Af_rho using Equation 1 (A'Hearn et al. 1984) from the 242.60 GHz continuum flux.
assumptions: nucleocentric distance rho ~ 6500 km (Bolin et al. 2024) and solar flux F_sun from Kurucz et al. (1984)

recipe.goal: Extract molecular spectra and fit LTE model and rotational diagram for CH3OH
recipe.method: Extract spectra from a 0.8'' circular region, fit LTE model using MCMC in CASSIS with CDMS database to derive column density and excitation temperature, and construct a rotational diagram to verify temperature.
assumptions: Local Thermodynamic Equilibrium (LTE) and optically thin emission lines

recipe.goal: Map spatial distribution of CH3OH emission
recipe.method: Create integrated intensity maps of four high-intensity CH3OH lines and fit 2D Gaussians using CASA task IMFIT to measure emitting region sizes.

recipe.goal: Derive CH3OH production rate, fractional abundance, and formation pathway
recipe.method: Calculate production rate Q for each of the 15 transitions using Equation 2 (Drahus et al. 2010), average them, divide by Q(H2O) to get fractional abundance, and compare with Garrod (2019) chemical model.
key_parameters: v_exp (half-width at half-maximum of each transition, ~0.75-0.86 km s^-1)
assumptions: Q_H2O = 4.8 x 10^28 molecules s^-1 (Schleicher et al. 2023)

recipe.goal: Derive upper limits for GMRT radio continuum and atomic HI column density
recipe.method: Measure upper limit continuum flux density at 1250 MHz, extract spectra from a 5.0'' diameter circular region at 1420 MHz, and compute upper limit HI column density using Equation 3 (Chengalur et al. 2013).
key_parameters: 5.0'' diameter circular extraction region; tau <= 0.23; int dv <= 0.36 km s^-1

score_reason: Both ALMA and GMRT raw datasets are public with project codes clearly given, and the main software (CASA 5.4.1, CASSIS, Astropy 5.0), calibrators, extraction apertures (1.7'', 0.8'', 5.0''), and analytic formulas are explicitly stated. However, standard TCLEAN imaging parameters (robust weighting, cell size, thresholds), the exact modified blackbody parametrization/priors, and the partition function values in Equation 2 are omitted.
rediscovery_reason: The ALMA dataset (2022.1.00997.T) is publicly available, the target is a single compact source, the extraction apertures and 15 CH3OH transitions are fully tabulated, and the main outputs (continuum fluxes, CH3OH line fluxes, column density, excitation temperature, and production rate) are concrete numeric targets.
